text:
anya: quick q — where do i look for per-pool kv cache lag + CPU saturation signal? trying to correlate spikes i saw on dedicated-prod-eu earlier.
ben: grafana has per-pool panels under Infra / Dedicated Pools -> Pool Overview -> Per-Pool Metrics. direct link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/PoolOverview?orgId=1&var-pool=d-ed-prod-eu :wave:
luis: also check datadog for traces and logs: `redwood.pool.<pool>.kvcache.lag` and `redwood.pool.<pool>.cpu.utilization` metrics. use `avg(last_5m)` for heatmaps.
anya: thx — any saved dashboard ids or panel ids? the grafana link was 403 for me.
sara: you need SSO group 'infra-grafana' access, ping @kevin if not in group.
kevin: granted you access, try again. if still 403, clear cookies.
anya: ok can open now. seeing kv lag spikes around 14:07 UTC. what should be our alerting heuristic?
ben: we had a runbook that suggested alert on `kvcache.miss_rate > 0.5` and `cpu.p95 > 85%` for >10m. but could be noisy during rollouts.
luis: alternative: alert on sustained increase in `kvcache.lag` combined with increased queue length: `kvcache.lag > 200ms && pool.request_queue > 25` for 5m.
sara: +1 to combining signals. If it's just CPU but no queue, maybe it's a noisy model compile or maintenance. check traces first.
anya: where are trace links? I only see logs and metrics.
ben: traces in Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.company/trace?service=pool-serving&pool=d-ed-prod-eu use trace id from logs: `trace_id=<id>`
luis: logs: https://logs.redwood.company/query?q=pool%3Dd-ed-prod-eu%20AND%20kvcache
kevin: for tuning, try lowering alert sensitivity and adding a suppress during canary deploys. example suppress rule in alert manager:
```
- name: pool_kv_cpu_suppress
  match:
    job: pool-metrics
  time_window: 00:30:00
  when: tag("deploy.stage") == "canary"
```
anya: nice, will propose that to oncall. one last thing — where can i find per-pool autoscale graphs (current replicas vs desired)?
ben: those are on the same grafana dashboard under 'Autoscaler' tab. panel name: 'Pool Replicas vs Desired'. link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/pool-autoscaler?var-pool=d-ed-prod-eu
luis: FYI pool autoscale decisions are logged to `pool-autoscaler` log group with config snapshots.
infra-bot: autoscaler event: pool=d-ed-prod-eu desired=12 actual=8 reason=kv_lag spike at 2026-03-05T14:08:12Z
anya: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll open a tiny PR to tweak the alert thresholds and add a suppress during canaries.
ben: ping me for review, thx
kevin: will review today :+1:
anya: PR: https://git.redwood.company/r/infra/alerts/+/1234
sara: adding to oncall checklist too.
